title: Chemical reaction
text: NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry announced live; activation and effect were not specified.

title: Ubers interaction
text: Three different Ubers styles from Aiku, Don Lorenzo, Niko and NEL Barou on the opponent's side trigger a cutscene and 30-second buff. Three players give 5%; four give 10% shot-only boost. The source lists Aiku/Niko speed, Lorenzo lower cooldown and Barou shot.

title: Rebellion chemistry
text: Snuffy passes to Barou using C. Barou must be next to the goalkeeper box with two opponents nearby and use Stealth-Kill Shot (C); an auto-goal cutscene was announced.

title: MVP scoring
text: At that date, a goal counted as 1 point and a save as 0.75 points for MVP selection.

title: Kaiser–Kiyora
text: Kiyora uses Borderline on Kaiser. Once the pass connects, Kaiser Volley changes to Kaiser Magnus; activate it to trigger chemistry.

title: Overtime awakening
text: One random player from each team receives awakening when overtime begins.

title: NEL Shidou–Charles
text: Charles uses Sky Arc Pass to NEL Shidou. Before the ball arrives, activate highlighted Dragon Header to trigger the chemistry.

title: NEL Isagi–Hiori
text: Hiori uses Hard Freeze Counter-Attack on NEL Isagi; after the cutscene, use highlighted Direct Shot before the window ends.

title: PS+ settings
text: Infinite stamina and infinite flow settings, plus hide-other-players' cosmetics setting.

title: Mobile controls
text: Movable mobile buttons introduced; further fixes and changes were planned.

title: Hitboxes and mobile controls
text: Private server setting shows skill hitboxes; mobile Fast Mode, lobby emote button and console/mobile PS+ commands menu announced.
